name: National MILO Marathon 2026 – Cebu Leg
short_description: The National MILO Marathon 2026 – Cebu Leg is a half-marathon and multi-distance race set for September 6, 2026, in Cebu City, Philippines.
ai_summary: The National MILO Marathon 2026 – Cebu Leg is scheduled for September 6, 2026, in Cebu City, Philippines. Organized by RUNRIO Inc., the event known for the MILO Marathon series, it offers multiple distance options including 1km, 3km, 5km, 10km, and a 21.1km half-marathon as the primary distance. Registration status has not yet been confirmed as open.
pros: Cheap entry: P1,799 for the 21 km and P499 for the 3 km in 2026
A route to the National Finals marathon: 21 km winners get an all-expenses place, and age-group qualifying times
Small 21 km field: 170 listed in 2026, with tenth place at 1:32 (men) and 2:20 (women)
Full 21 km and 10 km results with gun and chip times
21 km finishers get a medal, shirt, cap and loot bag
cons: Tight cut-offs: 2 hours 30 for the 21 km, with a 90-minute check at 10 km
Hot, wet air before dawn: 27°C to 28°C with a 24°C dew point in 2026
The 2026 race ran in haze rated unhealthy for sensitive groups
No route map, start times or aid-station plan on the 2026 race pages
Top-ten finishers are barred from later MILO races that season
research_highlights: The Cebu leg has historically been one of the largest regional legs in the whole Milo Marathon series, with a record field of over 24,000 runners in 2019 and over 16,000 in 2024
Recent editions used early gun starts to beat the heat: 21K starts at 4:30 a.m. (2h30m cut-off), 10K at 5:00 a.m. (1h30m cut-off), with 5K/3K/1K starting 5:30-5:45 a.m.

The exact host venue within Metro Cebu has moved in recent years — Cebu City Sports Center (2019 and earlier), Mandaue City (2024), and Lapu-Lapu City (2025) — so participants should confirm the specific start/finish location for the 2026 edition in advance
Local organizing has often involved Cebuano Olympian and six-time Milo Marathon champion Mary Joy Tabal, who has helped run the leg with RUNRIO and local city governments
Categories in recent Cebu-area editions have included 21K, 10K, 5K and 3K, with the 5K typically drawing the largest number of entrants
research_watchouts: Heat has been noted as a factor by organizers even with early morning start times ('a little bit hot')

The host city/venue for the Cebu leg has changed almost every year recently (Cebu City, Mandaue, Lapu-Lapu), so logistics like packet pick-up and start-line location are not consistent from year to year and should be double-checked close to race day

faqs.question: When is the National MILO Marathon 2026 – Cebu Leg taking place?
faqs.answer: The race is scheduled to take place on September 6, 2026. It will be held in Cebu City, Philippines. This date applies to all the distance categories offered at this particular leg of the National MILO Marathon series.

faqs.question: What distances can participants choose from at this race?
faqs.answer: Participants can choose from five distance options at this event: 1km, 3km, 5km, 10km, and 21.1km. The 21.1km half-marathon is listed as the primary distance for this race, making it the main featured category.

faqs.question: Is registration currently open for this race?
faqs.answer: According to available information, registration status for the National MILO Marathon 2026 – Cebu Leg has not yet been confirmed as open. Prospective participants should check back for updates on when sign-ups will officially begin for this event.

faqs.question: Who is organizing the National MILO Marathon 2026 – Cebu Leg?
faqs.answer: This race is organized by RUNRIO Inc., the organization behind the MILO Marathon series. The event takes place in Cebu City, Cebu, within the Philippines, as one leg of the broader national MILO Marathon circuit.
